error_message: Upgrade types exist in code but no upgrade selection UI screen is rendered — player cannot choose upgrades
root_cause: Upgrade type definitions and data structures were implemented but no UI rendering code was ever written for the upgrade selection screen; the game loop transitions past the upgrade step without rendering
regression_pattern: Upgrade type definitions without corresponding UI screen component
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RZ-001: Require upgrade UI screen component when upgrade types are defined — check for render function or scene matching upgrade selection

error_message: No audio system — game has no sound effects or music, reducing playability feedback
root_cause: Audio system was never implemented; no AudioContext, no sound files, no audio manager module
regression_pattern: Game project with zero audio imports or AudioContext usage
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RZ-002: Flag game projects with zero audio module imports or AudioContext references

error_message: No save system — player progress is lost on page refresh or close
root_cause: No localStorage, IndexedDB, or any persistence layer was implemented; game state lives only in memory
regression_pattern: Game state object with no serialization or persistence calls (localStorage/IndexedDB)
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RZ-003: Detect game-state classes without save/load methods or persistence calls

error_message: No meta-progression — no persistent upgrades, unlocks, or progression across runs
root_cause: Meta-progression system was never implemented; no persistent currency, no unlock tree, no cross-run progression data structures
regression_pattern: Game with complete core loop but no meta-progression data structures or persistent storage
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RZ-004: Flag roguelike/survivor games lacking meta-progression persistence layer

error_message: Game internally renamed to 'Robo-Z' but repo is 'rjl-zombie-plains' — identity mismatch causes confusion
root_cause: Project was renamed during development but repo name, package.json, and directory structure still reference the old name
regression_pattern: Repo name / package.json name field mismatch with in-game title
prevention_rule: PREVENT-RZ-005: Detect mismatch between repo directory name and package.json name or in-game title string
